extra_vocab.en: a meal that people eat outside, like in a park
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於「公司野餐（company picnic）」的活動通知，邀請員工和家人到公園或戶外一起用餐、玩遊戲。也可以當動詞，表示去野餐。

example.en: The company plans two picnics for staff every summer.
example.zh: 公司每年夏天為員工安排兩次野餐活動。

example.en: She picnics with her coworkers every Friday in summer.
example.zh: 夏天每個星期五她都和同事去野餐。

example.en: Staff picnicked by the lake after the team meeting.
example.zh: 團隊會議後，員工在湖邊野餐。

example.en: Some employees were picnicking near the river at noon.
example.zh: 中午有些員工正在河邊野餐。

example.en: Please sign up for the company picnic by Wednesday.
example.zh: 請在星期三前報名公司野餐活動。

example.en: Let's have a picnic in the park after the workshop.
example.zh: 工作坊結束後，我們去公園野餐吧。

example.en: Many families go on a picnic during the holiday weekend.
example.zh: 許多家庭在連假週末去野餐。

example.en: The picnic area is next to the parking lot.
example.zh: 野餐區就在停車場旁邊。

example.en: Please clean the picnic table after you finish eating.
example.zh: 吃完後，請把野餐桌清理乾淨。

examples.en: Our company picnic will be held at the park on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們的公司野餐將在星期六於公園舉行。

examples.en: Employees and their families are welcome to join the picnic.
examples.zh: 歡迎員工與家人一起參加野餐。

examples.en: The picnic was moved indoors because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 因為下大雨，野餐改到室內舉行。

similar.diff: 指團體的短程外出活動（不一定吃飯），如 company outing。

example.en: The team outing includes lunch and a boat ride.
example.zh: 這次團隊出遊包含午餐和遊船。

similar.diff: 指烤肉聚餐，重點在現場烤東西吃。

example.en: We will hold a barbecue for all staff on Friday.
example.zh: 我們星期五要為全體員工舉辦烤肉聚餐。

example.en: We packed sandwiches for the picnic at the lake.
example.zh: 我們為湖邊的野餐準備了三明治。

example.en: Colleagues often picnic together in the park at lunch time.
example.zh: 同事們午餐時間常在公園一起野餐。

extra_vocab.en: writing and forms that you must complete for work
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於入職、銀行、簽證、合約等情境，指要填寫、簽名、處理的表格與文件。常和 fill out、complete、sign 搭配。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: paperwork 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不說 a paperwork；用 some / a lot of / a piece of paperwork 表示數量。

example.en: Please fill out the paperwork and return it to HR.
example.zh: 請填寫這些文件並交回人資部門。

example.en: We need to complete the paperwork before the new hire starts.
example.zh: 新進員工上班前，我們必須完成文書作業。

example.en: I spent the morning doing paperwork at my desk.
example.zh: 我整個早上都在座位上處理文書工作。

example.en: The assistant will handle the paperwork for your visa.
example.zh: 助理會負責處理你的簽證文件。

example.en: Both sides must sign the paperwork by noon.
example.zh: 雙方必須在中午前簽署文件。

examples.en: New employees must finish the paperwork on their first day.
examples.zh: 新進員工必須在第一天完成文書手續。

examples.en: I have a lot of paperwork to complete before Friday.
examples.zh: 星期五前我有很多文書工作要完成。

examples.en: The bank will process your paperwork within three days.
examples.zh: 銀行會在三天內處理你的文件。

examples.en: Please bring all the paperwork to the visa office.
examples.zh: 請把所有文件帶到簽證辦事處。

confusable.diff: paper 是「紙、報紙、論文」；paperwork 是「文書作業」。
confusable.usage: paper 指「紙」時不可數，指「報紙、論文」時可數（a paper）；paperwork 永遠不可數。

example.en: Please print the report on A4 paper.
example.zh: 請把報告印在 A4 紙上。

similar.diff: 較正式，指一整套證明或說明文件。

example.en: Please submit the required documentation with your application.
example.zh: 請連同申請書一併提交所需的文件。

similar.diff: 只指要填寫的表格；paperwork 還包含處理表格的工作。

example.en: Please complete both forms and send them to the front desk.
example.zh: 請填好兩份表格並交給櫃檯。

senses.en: the work of filling in and handling forms

example.en: Too much paperwork slows down our hiring process.
example.zh: 太多文書作業拖慢了我們的招募流程。

senses.distinguish: 主詞或受詞是 the paperwork，後面接 is ready、is missing 時，指的是文件本身。

example.en: The paperwork is missing a signature on page two.
example.zh: 文件第二頁缺少簽名。

extra_vocab.en: how much work a person, team, or machine can do in a set time
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於管理、人資、工廠情境，談到提高員工或部門的效率。常搭配 increase、boost、improve 等動詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: productivity 是不可數名詞，不加 a，也不加 s。

example.en: Better training will increase productivity across all departments.
example.zh: 更好的訓練會提高各部門的生產力。

example.en: Regular breaks can boost productivity at work.
example.zh: 定時休息可以提升工作生產力。

example.en: The new schedule should improve productivity next quarter.
example.zh: 新的時程表應該能在下一季改善生產力。

example.en: High productivity helps the company stay competitive.
example.zh: 高生產力幫助公司保持競爭力。

example.en: We use productivity software to track our daily tasks.
example.zh: 我們用效率軟體來追蹤每天的工作。

examples.en: New software can raise office productivity by twenty percent.
examples.zh: 新軟體可以讓辦公室的生產力提高百分之二十。

examples.en: We discussed ways to improve team productivity this quarter.
examples.zh: 我們討論了本季提升團隊生產力的方法。

examples.en: Factory productivity fell after the old machines broke down.
examples.zh: 舊機器故障後，工廠的生產力下降了。

examples.en: Flexible hours often lead to higher productivity.
examples.zh: 彈性工時常能帶來更高的生產力。

confusable.diff: production 是「生產（過程）或產量」；productivity 是「生產的效率」。

example.en: Production will stop for two days during the repairs.
example.zh: 維修期間，生產將停止兩天。

similar.diff: 強調用較少的時間或資源完成工作；productivity 強調完成的量。

example.en: Efficiency improved after we changed the work process.
example.zh: 改變工作流程後，效率提高了。

example.en: The new system will increase our efficiency.
example.zh: 新系統會提高我們的效率。

example.en: The factory doubled its output this year.
example.zh: 這間工廠今年的產量增加了一倍。

derived.link: produce 是詞幹，表示做出、生產
produce 變成名詞 production，像 introduce → introduction
un-（不）+ productive，像 unhappy 的 un-

extra_vocab.zh: 簡報者、演講者；節目主持人
extra_vocab.en: a person who gives a talk or shows information to a group
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於研討會、訓練課程、會議的公告，指負責上台簡報或演講的人。也可指電視或廣播節目的主持人。

example.en: Three presenters will speak at the afternoon session.
example.zh: 下午的場次將有三位簡報者發言。

example.en: A guest presenter will join us for the training session.
example.zh: 一位特邀簡報者將參加我們的訓練課程。

example.en: The main presenter arrived early to test the screen.
example.zh: 主要簡報者提早抵達以測試螢幕。

example.en: Ms. Park will introduce the presenter at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 朴小姐將在九點介紹簡報者。

example.en: Please thank the presenter after the talk ends.
example.zh: 演講結束後，請向簡報者致謝。

examples.en: Each presenter has fifteen minutes to explain the project.
examples.zh: 每位簡報者有十五分鐘說明這個專案。

examples.en: We are looking for a presenter for next month's seminar.
examples.zh: 我們正在為下個月的講座尋找簡報者。

examples.en: The presenter showed sales charts on a large screen.
examples.zh: 簡報者在大螢幕上展示了銷售圖表。

confusable.diff: presentation 是「簡報」這件事；presenter 是做簡報的「人」。

example.en: Her presentation on the new budget was clear and short.
example.zh: 她關於新預算的簡報清楚又簡短。

similar.diff: 更通用，泛指任何在台上說話的人；presenter 偏重做簡報。

example.en: The keynote speaker will begin at ten o'clock.
example.zh: 主題演講者將在十點開始。

similar.diff: 負責主持活動、串場與招待；不一定要做簡報內容。

example.en: The host welcomed the guests and explained the schedule.
example.zh: 主持人歡迎賓客並說明行程。

derived.link: present 是詞幹，表示把東西呈現給大家看

senses.en: a person who gives a talk to a group

example.en: The presenter answered questions after her talk.
example.zh: 簡報者在演講後回答了問題。

senses.en: a person who hosts a TV or radio program
senses.distinguish: 出現在電視、廣播、節目的情境時，指主持人。

example.en: The radio presenter interviewed the company's new director.
example.zh: 廣播主持人訪問了公司的新任主管。

extra_vocab.en: a machine that makes copies of papers
extra_vocab.note: 多益辦公室情境非常常見，常出現在影印機故障、卡紙、補紙、維修的對話或公告。美式也常說 copier 或 copy machine。

example.en: Both photocopiers on the second floor need new toner.
example.zh: 二樓的兩台影印機都需要換新的碳粉。

example.en: May I use the photocopier for a few pages?
example.zh: 我可以用影印機印幾頁嗎？

example.en: A technician will fix the photocopier this afternoon.
example.zh: 技術人員今天下午會來修理影印機。

example.en: Please load paper into the photocopier when the tray is empty.
example.zh: 紙匣空了時，請把紙放進影印機。

example.en: There is a paper jam in the photocopier again.
example.zh: 影印機又卡紙了。

examples.en: The photocopier is out of order, so please use the one downstairs.
examples.zh: 影印機故障了，請用樓下那一台。

examples.en: The new photocopier can also scan and send documents by email.
examples.zh: 新的影印機也能掃描文件並用電子郵件寄出。

examples.en: We plan to buy a faster photocopier for the sales office.
examples.zh: 我們打算為業務辦公室買一台速度較快的影印機。

confusable.diff: photographer 是「攝影師」；photocopier 是「影印機」，兩者都有 photo- 開頭，但意思不同。

example.en: We hired a photographer to take pictures at the event.
example.zh: 我們請了攝影師在活動中拍照。

similar.diff: 較短、較常用的說法，意思相同。

example.en: The copier in the lobby is free for guests.
example.zh: 大廳的影印機提供給訪客免費使用。

similar.diff: 美式口語常用，意思和 photocopier 相同。

example.en: Someone left a report on the copy machine.
example.zh: 有人把一份報告留在影印機上。

example.en: The printer on my floor ran out of ink.
example.zh: 我們樓層的印表機沒墨水了。

example.en: Use the scanner to send the contract by email.
example.zh: 請用掃描器把合約用電子郵件寄出。

derived.link: photocopier 去掉 -er 並把 i 換回 y，就是 photocopy；photocopy + -er，做影印的機器，像 printer、scanner

extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to paint walls or buildings, or to paint pictures
extra_vocab.note: 多益在辦公室整修、大樓維修的情境常指「油漆工」；在藝廊、展覽的情境則指「畫家」，要從上下文判斷。

example.en: Two painters will start work in the lobby on Monday.
example.zh: 兩位油漆工星期一會開始在大廳施工。

example.en: A house painter gave us a price for the whole building.
example.zh: 一位房屋油漆工給了我們整棟大樓的報價。

example.en: We need to hire a painter before the office opens.
example.zh: 辦公室開幕前，我們得僱一位油漆工。

example.en: A professional painter finished the walls in just two days.
example.zh: 一位專業油漆工只花兩天就刷完牆面。

example.en: The gallery will show works by a famous painter.
example.zh: 藝廊將展出一位著名畫家的作品。

examples.en: The painter said the walls will be dry by Friday.
examples.zh: 油漆工說牆面到星期五就會乾。

examples.en: The painter will talk about her new works at the opening.
examples.zh: 這位畫家會在開幕式上談她的新作品。

examples.en: Please move your desks before the painters arrive tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 請在明天早上油漆工抵達前把桌子移開。

confusable.diff: printer 是「印表機」或「印刷業者」；painter 是「油漆工、畫家」，拼法和發音都相近。

example.en: The printer will deliver the brochures on Wednesday.
example.zh: 印刷業者星期三會送來宣傳手冊。

similar.diff: 泛指藝術家，不一定畫畫；painter 指畫畫的人。

example.en: The artist designed the poster for our event.
example.zh: 這位藝術家為我們的活動設計了海報。

similar.diff: 指室內裝潢師，負責布置與配色，不一定動手刷漆。

example.en: The decorator chose new colors for the meeting room.
example.zh: 室內裝潢師為會議室挑選了新的顏色。

derived.link: paint 是詞幹；paint + -er，做事的人，像 teacher、worker
paint + -ing，把畫畫的結果變成名詞

senses.en: a person who paints walls, doors, or buildings

example.en: The painter will repaint the reception area this weekend.
example.zh: 油漆工這個週末會重新粉刷接待區。

senses.distinguish: 出現在藝廊、展覽、作品、美術館的情境時，指畫家。

example.en: The museum bought a painting by a local painter.
example.zh: 美術館買了一位在地畫家的作品。

extra_vocab.en: a person who often uses a shop, restaurant, or library, or who gives money to support something
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳、圖書館、劇院的公告，用 patron 稱呼「客人、使用者」，語氣比 customer 正式客氣，如 Patrons are asked to…。

example.en: Patrons are asked to turn off their phones during the show.
example.zh: 演出期間，請顧客關閉手機。

example.en: Mr. Chen is a regular patron of our cafe.
example.zh: 陳先生是我們咖啡館的常客。

example.en: We give a free drink to every loyal patron.
example.zh: 我們請每位忠實顧客喝一杯免費飲料。

example.en: Dear valued patron, thank you for visiting our hotel.
example.zh: 親愛的貴賓，感謝您蒞臨我們的飯店。

example.en: Each library patron may borrow up to five books.
example.zh: 每位圖書館讀者最多可以借五本書。

examples.en: Patrons may leave their coats at the front desk.
examples.zh: 顧客可以把外套寄放在櫃檯。

examples.en: Most of our patrons come for the quick lunch menu.
examples.zh: 我們大部分的客人是為了快速午餐菜單而來。

examples.en: The theater thanked its patrons for their generous support.
examples.zh: 劇院感謝贊助者慷慨的支持。

confusable.diff: patient 是「病人」或「有耐心的」；patron 是「顧客、贊助者」，兩個字拼法與發音相近。
confusable.usage: patient 可當名詞（病人）或形容詞（有耐心的）；patron 只當名詞。

example.en: The clinic called each patient to confirm the appointment.
example.zh: 診所打電話給每位病人確認預約。

similar.diff: 最通用的「顧客」；patron 較正式，且常指經常光顧的人。

example.en: Every customer receives a receipt after payment.
example.zh: 每位顧客付款後都會拿到收據。

similar.diff: 多指接受專業服務的客戶（律師、顧問）；patron 多指店家或場所的客人。

example.en: Our client asked us to change the contract.
example.zh: 我們的客戶要求我們修改合約。

derived.link: patron + -age，客人光顧或支持的行為，像 usage、package

senses.en: a person who often uses a shop, restaurant, or library

example.en: The restaurant thanked its patrons for a great year.
example.zh: 餐廳感謝顧客帶來精彩的一年。

senses.en: a person who gives money to support an artist or group
senses.distinguish: 後面接 of the arts、of the museum，或前後提到捐款、支持時，指贊助者。

example.en: She is a patron of the arts and gives money every year.
example.zh: 她是藝術的贊助者，每年都會捐款。

extra_vocab.en: a paper from a doctor that lets you buy a certain medicine
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於藥局與診所的情境，如領藥、補藥、保險是否給付。常搭配 fill、refill、write 等動詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「憑處方」可說 with a prescription 或 on prescription（on prescription 不加 a）；「不需要處方」是 without a prescription。

example.en: The pharmacy fills about two hundred prescriptions every day.
example.zh: 這間藥局每天配發大約兩百張處方箋的藥。

example.en: You can fill a prescription at the pharmacy downstairs.
example.zh: 你可以在樓下的藥局按處方配藥。

example.en: The doctor wrote a prescription for the cough.
example.zh: 醫生針對咳嗽開了處方。

example.en: Please call us early if you need to refill a prescription.
example.zh: 如果需要續領處方藥，請提早打電話給我們。

example.en: Prescription drugs cannot be sold without a doctor's note.
example.zh: 處方藥沒有醫生的證明不能販售。

examples.en: Your prescription will be ready in about twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 您的處方藥大約二十分鐘後就會準備好。

examples.en: Please show your insurance card when you pick up the prescription.
examples.zh: 領處方藥時，請出示您的保險卡。

examples.en: Our health plan covers most prescription costs for employees.
examples.zh: 我們的健康保險涵蓋員工大部分的處方藥費用。

confusable.diff: subscription 是「訂閱」（雜誌、服務）；prescription 是「處方」，拼法與發音相近。

example.en: Our magazine subscription ends at the end of December.
example.zh: 我們的雜誌訂閱到十二月底結束。

confusable.diff: description 是「描述、說明」；prescription 是「處方」。

example.en: Please read the job description before you apply.
example.zh: 申請前請先閱讀職務說明。

example.en: The pharmacy is open until nine o'clock at night.
example.zh: 藥局營業到晚上九點。

example.en: Take this medicine twice a day after meals.
example.zh: 這種藥請在飯後一天吃兩次。

example.en: The pharmacist explained how to take the medicine.
example.zh: 藥劑師說明了這種藥怎麼服用。

derived.link: prescribe 是動詞，去掉 -be 加 -ption 變成名詞，像 describe → description

senses.en: a paper from a doctor that says what medicine you need

example.en: Please bring your prescription to the pharmacy counter.
example.zh: 請把處方箋帶到藥局櫃檯。

senses.en: the medicine that a doctor tells you to take
senses.distinguish: 出現在 pick up、ready、cost 等字旁邊時，指的是藥品本身，而不是那張紙。

example.en: I need to pick up my prescription after work.
example.zh: 下班後我得去領我的處方藥。
